# Oliv AI product documentation

> Official product documentation for Oliv AI, AI agents for sales, customer success and RevOps teams that work on a context layer on top of the CRM. Each page states who it applies to, its status and when it was verified.

## Pages
- [AI sales platform docs: how Oliv AI's agents and apps work, and which guide to open first](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/index.md): Find which AI sales platform guide to open first with Oliv AI: prepare for a meeting, size up the agents, connect your CRM or assign seats.
- [AI sales agents: which Oliv AI agent owns which job, and which workflow to start with](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/index.md): Which AI sales agent to open for the job in front of you: Olivia to ask for work, Oliver to set the rules, a specialist for one job, and the builder pages to see how any agent is set up.
- [No code AI agent builder: how an Oliv AI agent is set up and how much it may do alone](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/index.md): Before an agent acts on your CRM and inbox, use this no-code AI agent builder guide to check what it does, how much it may do alone, when it starts, what it reads and what it did.
- [AI agent instructions: how to read an agent's process and trace each step to its tool](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/instructions/index.md): How to read AI agent instructions in Oliv AI: the Objective, Process and Output on the Instructions tab, and how to trace each process step to the tool it uses.
- [AI agent knowledge base: how to check which files an agent has and add your own to it](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/knowledge/index.md): How to run an AI agent knowledge base in Oliv AI: check and open each agent's files on the Knowledge tab, add your own in the formats it names, and plan around what the tab can't do.
- [AI agent audit trail: read each run's type, status and record before you widen an agent](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/run-history/index.md): An AI agent audit trail guide: read an agent's Runs tab and open a run record to check every email the agent wrote, the people it picked, a sequence's steps or a drafted reply.
- [Human in the loop AI: set each agent tool to Auto Run, Requires Approval or Agent Decides](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/tools-and-run-modes/index.md): Choose which actions an Oliv AI agent runs alone and which wait for a person: human-in-the-loop AI set tool by tool, with Auto Run, Requires Approval or Agent Decides.
- [AI agent triggers: see what starts each agent, from CRM events and messages to schedules](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/builder/triggers/index.md): How event-triggered AI agents start in Oliv AI: where to read each agent's triggers and schedules, how the trigger picker is laid out, how to set a schedule, and how to check automatic runs.
- [Sales coaching software: how Oliv AI's Coach scores recorded calls and recommends goals](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/coach/index.md): How sales coaching software lets you coach from recorded calls: Oliv AI's Coach agent scores them, recommends three goals per rep each month for you to set, tracks progress every week, and how it compares.
- [CRM automation for sales teams: how Oliv AI's CRM Manager updates every record](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/crm-manager/index.md): CRM automation with Oliv AI's CRM Manager agent: what it writes after every activity, how reps review its updates, when to switch to Auto-Pilot, and how it compares with other CRM automation tools.
- [CRM field mapping: how to get AI updates into the right standard and custom fields](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/crm-manager/field-mapping/index.md): How to map your team's standard, methodology and custom opportunity fields so Oliv AI's CRM Manager agent writes each update to the right place, then review and automate it.
- [Deal intelligence software for sales managers: how Oliv AI's Deal Driver flags deal risk](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/deal-driver/index.md): Deal intelligence software for sales managers: what Oliv AI's Deal Driver agent sends each day and week, which deal risks trigger an alert, how to set it up, and how it compares with other tools.
- [Sales forecasting software: how Oliv AI's Forecaster builds the number before reps log in](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/forecaster/index.md): How Oliv AI's Forecaster agent drafts each rep's forecast, suggests category moves with a reason on each deal, rolls the number up through every manager, and how it compares with other sales forecasting software.
- [AI meeting assistant: how Oliv AI briefs you before deal meetings and drafts the follow-up](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/meeting-assistant/index.md): How Oliv AI's Meeting Assistant agent works as an AI meeting assistant for sales: what it sends before each deal meeting, what it drafts and flags after the call, how to set it up, and how it compares with other AI meeting assistants.
- [Revenue operations software: how Oliv AI's Oliver keeps every agent on one sales process](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/oliver/index.md): How revenue operations software keeps one sales process across your tools: what Oliv AI's Oliver agent holds in the process handbook, how a change gets approved and how every agent then follows it.
- [AI sales assistant: how Oliv AI's Olivia prepares you for calls and asks before she acts](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/agents/olivia/index.md): How Oliv AI's Olivia agent works as an AI sales assistant: how to ask her questions and hand her work, what she needs connected, and how she compares with other AI sales assistants.
- [AI sales apps: which Oliv AI app does which job, and which plan or add-on brings it](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/index.md): AI sales apps your team works in: which Oliv AI app to open to find a conversation, read a forecast board, coach a rep or run outreach, and which seat or add-on brings it.
- [Conversation intelligence software: capture customer conversations and find what was said](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/converse/index.md): How to set up conversation intelligence in Oliv AI: what it captures across meetings, phone calls, email and Slack, what you get after a conversation, and which Converse page to open next.
- [Sales call clips: define the moments, then build libraries from new recordings](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/converse/clips/index.md): How to collect and share sales call clips without scrubbing recordings: define the moments, let Oliv AI clip new recordings into libraries on the Enable add-on, and share them in Slack or by link.
- [AI meeting notes: read one meeting across seven tabs, from takeaways to CRM updates](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/converse/meeting-details/index.md): AI meeting notes for one customer meeting: how to read the takeaways, tasks, qualification evidence, coaching, attendees and CRM updates across seven tabs, check them against the recording, share a moment, and how Oliv AI compares.
- [Sales call library: find a past customer meeting by search, filter or a Slack link](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/converse/meetings/index.md): How to find a past customer meeting in a sales call library, by date, by phrase, by filter or from a Slack link, and open its recording, transcript and notes in Oliv AI.
- [AI meeting recorder: how Oliv AI records with or without a bot, and what attendees see](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/converse/recording-modes/index.md): How an AI meeting recorder can capture customer meetings with or without a bot: Oliv AI chooses by who organized the meeting, and this page covers what attendees see, how to prepare meetings and how it compares with other recorders.
- [Engage app](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/apps/engage/index.md): What Oliv AI's Engage app does for outbound teams, from the multichannel Inbox and signal-driven plays to the power dialer with a call plan for every contact, and how it compares with other sales engagement tools.
- [Capabilities](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/capabilities/index.md): Every Oliv AI capability in one catalog, grouped by agents, agent building, autonomy, conversation capture, opportunity and account management, add-ons, context and integrations.
- [How to roll out AI sales agents: a 30-day plan from admin access to the day-30 review](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/getting-started/plan-your-deployment/index.md): A 30-day plan for an AI sales agent rollout across sales and customer success, from choosing who runs the setup and lining up admin access to the first brief, the process handbook and the day-30 review.
- [Sales tool integrations: what connects to Oliv AI, what it does and which guide to open](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/index.md): Sales tool integrations for Oliv AI: what connects, what each connection does, what to connect first and which of the six setup guides to open.
- [Gmail](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/gmail/index.md): How Oliv AI connects to Gmail, files every customer email against the right deal, drafts replies for you to review and gives the agents you build nine Gmail actions.
- [HubSpot AI integration: how to connect Oliv AI, approve updates and show fields on deals](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/hubspot/index.md): How to connect Oliv AI to HubSpot, show Oliv AI fields on deal records, decide how updates are approved, and see what Oliv AI keeps current in your portal.
- [Salesforce AI integration: how to connect Oliv AI and control what it writes to your org](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/salesforce/index.md): How to connect Oliv AI to Salesforce, choose how CRM updates are reviewed, clean up existing data, and see what Oliv AI writes to your org.
- [Slack sales alerts: which messages Oliv AI sends, when they arrive and who gets each one](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/slack/index.md): Which sales alerts in Slack Oliv AI sends, when each one arrives, who gets it, how to connect Slack, how to count your weekly messages and how to turn them off.
- [Webex](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/webex/index.md): How Oliv AI joins your Webex meetings from the Webex App Hub, sends meeting prep before each call, and shares a summary with action items and next steps afterward.
- [Zoom AI note taker: record with or without a bot and update deal data during the call](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/integrations/zoom/index.md): How to run a Zoom AI note taker on customer calls: Oliv AI's two Zoom apps, host consent, the lobby, recording when the host is absent, and updating CRM fields inside Zoom.
- [How Oliv AI billing works: plans, add-ons and credits, and how each one is counted](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/plans/index.md): How to read an Oliv AI bill: which plan each person takes, which add-ons go on top, how AI agent actions are billed in credits, and where to find every current figure.
- [Which Oliv AI plan do I need? Match each person to Converse, Sell, Grow or Amplify](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/plans/plans-and-seat-roles/index.md): Decide which seat each person on your revenue team needs, using four questions, a sorted example of a 34-person org and what Converse, Sell, Grow and Amplify each add.
- [AI quality and accuracy](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/platform/ai-quality-and-accuracy/index.md): How Oliv AI keeps agent output reviewable, from approvals and run modes to run records and the reason behind every CRM update.
- [Context, process and signal graphs](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/platform/graphs/index.md): The three graphs underneath Oliv AI's agents, what each one holds, how it stays current, and which agents read it before they act.
- [AI agents for CRM: how Oliv AI sits on top of your CRM and what it reads and writes](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/platform/oliv-and-your-crm/index.md): How Oliv AI works as a layer on top of Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho, what it reads and writes back, how updates are approved, and why your CRM stays the system of record.
- [Product summary](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/product-summary/index.md): A factual summary of Oliv AI, the AI agents it runs for revenue teams, the apps they work in, where you use them, who they're for and how Oliv AI is sold.

- [CRM hygiene in five steps: how to keep your CRM updated after every call and email](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/workflows/keep-the-crm-updated/index.md): CRM hygiene in five steps: how Oliv AI keeps Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho current from every meeting, call and email, how to review proposed updates before they're written, and how to run a monthly CRM hygiene check.
- [AI meeting preparation: how to get a deal brief and first-meeting research before you join](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs-v3/product-docs/workflows/prepare-for-a-meeting/index.md): How Oliv AI prepares you for a sales meeting, from the deal brief that arrives 30 minutes before the call to first-meeting research on a new contact, and how to use both.
